contract: Each author_jsx receives a precreated 320x180 2s 24fps comp, mediaRoot, and linearKeys(property,times,values). Create a distinct Adobe-native AEP and independently Adobe-rendered full-duration 30fps MP4 for every target. Record actual AEP hash/bytes/composition ID and independently verified long-term MP4 Asset ID/hash/bytes after authoring, not before. These requests and the explicit FX inputs are NOT independent Adobe proof. Font resolution and RGB fidelity remain unmeasured. Never overwrite an existing oracle.
